base:
Use case: illustration-story. Production character cutout for the ASTRA music video.
Image 1 is the sole authoritative character and style reference. Make a new full-body pose of this SAME adult dragon woman. Match her head, sweeping fringe, broad flowing locks, segmented horns, pointed ears, cross/diamond high collar and viewer-right temple openwork knot with diamond tassel. Extend into an elegant long draping dress, dragon wings and a tapering curled tail, all in the SAME bold cut-paper language.
ONLY THREE SOLID FLAT INKS: near-black plum #292135 for all face and skin shapes, light dusty lavender #aa8cc4 for broad hair and fabric planes, middle purple #71558c for shadow cut planes. No gradients. No outlines around each hair strand. No pale skin, no normal shaded anime painting, no glossy shading. Face is a quiet DARK NEGATIVE SHAPE, without eyes, nose or mouth. Cute and cool personality comes from head tilt and silhouette.
The GPT six-interlocking-loop knot at her viewer-right temple must be DRAWN DIRECTLY AS PART OF THIS ARTWORK, with the same purple ink and natural edges as her hair. Six interwoven rounded ribbon loops with visible over-under joins and hollow gaps, NOT a six-petal pinwheel. Its outside edge follows the six loops, with NO surrounding ring, NO disk, NO medallion backing, NO white logo sticker. Keep the short diamond chain and tassel. Another small matching naturally drawn openwork knot can fasten the dress at the hip. Do not omit the GPT ornament.
Full character entirely inside frame, comfortable margin above BOTH horn tips, below hem/tail, and around wings. Clean actual transparent background. Correct shoulders/elbows/wrists and hand laterality, five fingers each if visible. Strong large shapes, minimal inner linework. No lettering, no interface, no ground shadow, no surrounding frame.

poses.stand: POSE: A relaxed upright standing pose, slight frontal three-quarter turn towards viewer-right, gentle inquisitive head tilt. One hand loosely holds a slim lavender drawing stylus down at her side; the other hand rests lightly over her chest. Wings compact but clearly recognizable. Calm, approachable, self-possessed silhouette. Long dress and flowing hair create a balanced full-body outline.
poses.reach: POSE: A graceful opening gesture, frontal three-quarter toward viewer-right. Her anatomical LEFT arm, on viewer-right, extends outward with an open palm offered toward the sky; thumb placement and wrist must be correct. Her RIGHT hand near waist lightly holds a slim lavender stylus. Wings unfurl generously on both sides, hair and fabric sweep to viewer-left. Head lifts with curiosity and freedom. Full fingers, full wings, full tail inside frame.
poses.protect: POSE: She bends her head slightly forward and protectively cups BOTH hands together at her chest. The upward-facing palms form a clearly readable small EMPTY bowl-shaped opening; draw NOTHING in that opening. This empty space will later hold her treasured star. Hands anatomically correct and countable, forearms converge naturally. Wings fold around her, shoulders drawn inward; long flowing dress and tail enclose the silhouette. Quiet protective tenderness and resolve, no pen.
poses.sit: POSE: She sits sideways on an INVISIBLE ledge, three-quarter toward viewer-right, both legs gracefully together beneath flowing long dress. Her back is upright and relaxed, head gently turned toward viewer-right as if patiently waiting for a response. Her anatomical RIGHT forearm crosses gently over her lap and holds a slim lavender stylus angled toward viewer-right, its tip clearly unobstructed past her knee. Other hand rests relaxed on her lap. Wings rest folded behind; tail curls below and around, hair drapes in broad flowing locks. No chair, no ledge illustration, only the character cutout.
